lines.english: "Haah, it's over!"
"That was good… right?"
"You don't think it was good? Everyone gave a massive applause at the end."
"Y-You're right… Touma-san was amazing, wasn't she?"
"Well, I can't say with confidence that I really understood… but she barely made any mistakes."
"Yes, even I could tell that much. It sounded so precise that it felt like I was listening to a CD. Like something I can listen to and relax."
"Yeah, she really is good, that Touma. Though perhaps it's rude to call a professional 'good.'"
"…She used to be someone in the same grade as us."
"More specifically, she was even in the same club as me. She used to call me President, you know?"
"Even things like that happened, didn't they…?"
"Things like that did happen… long ago."
"Yes…"
"It's all in the past."
"…Haruki didn't come."
"In other words, you know what this means."
"Well then, let's go home. I can walk you home at least, right?"
"…I was expecting you to say, 'Wanna hang out?' at some point."
"You have to wake up early tomorrow, right? You told me you had a conference in the morning."
"Ooh, you really have grown up, Takeya."
"I'm perfectly free until morning. I've just learned to start thinking about others a little."
"Isn't that called growing up?"
"At least call it being 'A full-fledged member of society.' I'm still the same age as you, you know?"
"We'll always remain the same age."
"Come on, let's go. We'll only get cold if we stand still talking in this place."
"Right…"
"It really is cold… it might even snow."
"…Wanna hang out?"
"What are you doing? Don't just stand there, come already!"
"Yes, yes… Here we go!"
"I didn't tell you to run! You're wearing heels today too, aren't you!?"
"…Haah."
"Oh, there you are, President. I was looking for you."
"Aah, sorry, Miyo-chan. Come to think of it, I did have a lot of incoming calls."
"Why are you standing around in this cold place? Aren't you going to enter the dressing room?"
"…No one can enter right now."
"…? Oh, right, the press conference has been ready to start for a while now."
"Aah… sorry. Cancel that."
"Eh… why? There are quite a lot of people gathered."
"Not sure how to answer that… Well, a lot has happened."
"W-W-Wha…What was that just now?"
"There are lots of things in this world… that one is better off not knowing about…"
"…I'm not sure I understand."
"Regardless… It would be troublesome if any journalists came here. I'm sorry, but apologize to them and have them leave."
"…I understand that much, at least."
"I'm sorry. I'll make sure to raise your wages a little this month."
"Then if you'll excuse me, I'll be right back."
"Ah, and Miyo-chan?"
"Yes?"
"Could you call a taxi while you're at it? Tell them to drive up to the backdoor of the concert hall."
"But we already have a car ready in another 30 minutes…"
"We might not have that much time. Please, call for another one as soon as possible."
"Ah, could it be that… you're planning on making Kazusa-san flee?"
"No…"
"I'm the passenger."
